'''Fusion-cutter grenades''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], fusion-cutter grenades were carried by a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] when they boarded the [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']] to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a New Republic [[General/Legends|general]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />
